info.title: Lensmor API
info.description: Lensmor Event Intelligence API for event discovery, exhibitor research, personnel lookup, credits, and profile matching.

tags.name: Credits
tags.description: Inspect the credit balance available to the authenticated API key owner.

tags.name: Actions
tags.description: Preflight access and credit-sensitive actions before executing them.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Discover, inspect, score, rank, and unlock trade show event records.

tags.name: Exhibitors
tags.description: Search and inspect exhibiting companies and their related events.

tags.name: Personnel
tags.description: Browse event personnel, related events, LinkedIn activity, and outreach content.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Search contacts and run asynchronous email or phone unlock workflows.

tags.name: Profile Matching
tags.description: Apply a buyer profile to rank events and recommend exhibitors.

get.description: Return subscription, add-on, gift, and total credits for the authenticated API key owner without spending credits.

post.description: Evaluate access and expected credit behavior for a supported action without executing or charging it.

get.description: Search and filter the event catalog by keyword, geography, date, type, and quality with pagination. Event items include hasVisitors when registered Visitor data is available; the public event list does not currently expose a has_visitors query filter.

items.name: CES 2025
items.description: Consumer technology trade show in Las Vegas.

get.description: Return the detailed public event record for one Lensmor event identifier, including hasVisitors when registered Visitor data is available.

event.name: CES 2025
event.description: Consumer technology trade show in Las Vegas.

get.description: Return a lightweight event record with coverage counts, top categories, and data freshness.

post.description: Calculate a profile-dependent fit score and rationale for one event without unlocking it.
Rank a supplied set of event identifiers against the authenticated user's profile.
Unlock base event access for complete exhibitor and personnel results. A first unlock can consume 2,000 credits, repeated unlocks are idempotent, and the separate visitor data layer is not included.

Unlock visitor records for an event that already has base event access. The first successful visitor unlock consumes 3,000 credits, requires an active subscription and available visitor data, and repeated unlocks are idempotent.
Atomically unlock base event access and visitor access, charging only for missing access layers: 2,000 credits for base event access and 3,000 credits for visitor access, up to 5,000 credits total.

get.description: Return paginated exhibitors for an event with preview or full-access semantics and visible coverage counts.

post.description: Search exhibitor records using a company website URL or target-audience context.
Run a precision-first exhibitor lookup by company name. A non-empty result consumes 50 credits; an empty result does not consume credits.

post.summary: Search events by exhibitor company name
post.description: Find events associated with a company name. A non-empty result consumes 50 credits; an empty result does not consume credits.

get.description: Return the public company profile for one exhibitor identifier.
Return paginated events associated with one exhibitor identifier.

Return paginated people for an event with event-scoped attendee source labels and preview or full base-event access semantics. The sourceType array can contain exhibitor, social, and visitors; labels are not mutually exclusive. Use the sourceType query parameter to filter by one supported attendee source. Visitor is a separate access layer, so semantics.accessMode does not by itself confirm Visitor access.

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: Filter personnel by one event-scoped attendee source label. Supported values are exhibitor, social, and visitors.

get.description: Return the public professional profile for one personnel identifier. The sourceType array can aggregate non-exclusive attendee source labels across the person's associated events.
Return paginated events associated with one personnel identifier.

get.summary: List personnel related events by LinkedIn URL
get.description: Resolve a public LinkedIn profile URL to a personnel record and its related events.

get.summary: Search personnel related events by name
get.description: Return a paginated, deduplicated event list for up to 50 personnel records whose full name exactly matches the supplied name. This endpoint requires an active paid user. A non-empty result consumes 50 credits; an empty result consumes 0 credits. At most 10 requests can run concurrently for one user.

parameters.name: person_name
parameters.description: Exact personnel full name. Matching is case-insensitive and ignores leading and trailing whitespace.

parameters.name: date_start_from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound for the event start date. Defaults to the current date when omitted.

parameters.name: date_start_to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound for the event start date. Omit for no upper bound.

200.description: Paginated events, or a business-error envelope when the per-user concurrency limit is exceeded

value.message: Too many concurrent requests for this endpoint

post.description: Start asynchronous LinkedIn activity analysis for one or more personnel records in an event context.

get.description: Search public contact records by required company name and optional role or person-name filters. Returned sourceType arrays can aggregate non-exclusive attendee source labels across associated events.

post.description: Start an asynchronous email unlock task that can consume 15 credits per chargeable contact.

201.description: Unlock submission accepted, or completed with no chargeable work

get.description: Poll an email unlock task and inspect terminal job status plus item-level email results.

post.summary: Apply profile and get recommended events
post.description: Apply profile-matching input synchronously and return a paginated list of recommended events without spending credits.

get.description: Return paginated exhibitors recommended for the authenticated user's profile within one event.

200.description: Paginated recommendation state or unranked fallback exhibitor rows

items.reason: Strong fit for the active profile.

post.description: Start an asynchronous phone unlock task that consumes 150 credits per chargeable contact.

201.description: Phone unlock submission accepted, or completed with no chargeable work

get.description: Poll a phone unlock task and inspect terminal job status plus item-level phone results.

post.description: Start asynchronous AI outreach generation for one or more personnel records and selected channels.

get.description: Return the most recent generated outreach content for one personnel and event combination.

bearerAuth.description: Send the full Business API key from Settings -> API Keys, for example `Authorization: Bearer sk_your_api_key`.

sponsor_match_starred.description: Filter to events whose Sponsor Match starred state is 0 or 1. Omit the field to include both states.

hasVisitors.description: True when the event currently has registered Visitor data available. This is an availability signal, not proof that the caller has unlocked Visitor access.

sponsorMatchStarred.description: Sponsor Match starred state returned by Lensmor.

score.description: Overall event fit score on a 0-10 scale.

recommendation.description: Decision category derived from score: recommended for 7-10, consider for 4 to below 7, and not_recommended for below 4.

profile_match.description: Profile-context compatibility component on a 0-10 scale.

matched_exhibitor_density.description: Matched-exhibitor density component on a 0-10 scale. This is not verified buyer or attendee density.

event_scale.description: Event-scale component derived from the Lensmor exhibitor count and capped at 10.

isRecommended.description: True only when the item belongs to the active recommendation snapshot.

reason.description: Recommendation reason when matchStatus is ready. The field name is reason, not matchReason.

recommendationProcessing.description: True when recommendation detail generation is still processing for the event.

show_refresh_hint.description: Present on fallback results. This flag does not identify the cause or prescribe a required action.

buyingSignalStatus.description: Latest buying-signal batch state. On /external/exhibitors/list it is one of ready, processing, pending, or null. On the search endpoints it is always null.

sourceType.description: Lensmor source/business labels for this person. Source labels are not mutually exclusive. Product mapping: Exhibitor is exhibitor, Social Signals is social, and Visitor is visitors. Visitor represents registered attendees obtained through organizer or data-provider partnerships; Social Signals is not proof of official registration. Event personnel lists return event-scoped labels, while personnel profile and contact search can aggregate labels across associated events.

outreachMessageStatus.description: Current outreach generation state when this endpoint includes outreach metadata.

outreachMessageChannels.description: Generated or requested outreach channels when outreach metadata is present.

status.description: accepted when an asynchronous task was created; success when there was no chargeable work to enqueue.

task_id.description: TaskCenter identifier. Present when status is accepted.

job_id.description: Alias of task_id. Present when status is accepted.

linkedin_message_types.description: LinkedIn message variants to generate when linkedin_message is requested.

taskCenterId.description: TaskCenter identifier returned when at least one outreach generation task was created.

status.description: Current outreach message status, such as processing, ready, or failed. Null when no record exists.

create_time.description: Record creation timestamp in milliseconds. Null when no record exists.

update_time.description: Record update timestamp in milliseconds. Null when no record exists.
